scene: A sunlit forest clearing, lush emerald canopy framing the sides, enormous layered trees in the distance, soft golden sunbeams, mossy rocks only at the far edges, fresh grass and a broad pale green earthen clearing. Rich greens, warm light, serene adventurous feeling.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original local background for a two-dimensional creature battle game. Create a beautiful high-quality hand-painted 2D game environment with crisp large pixel-like color clusters and clean edges, evoking polished Nintendo DS-era monster RPG environments at modern resolution, not a screenshot or interface. Landscape 16:9 composition, 1536 by 864 if possible. Low camera looking across a wide continuous ground plane, horizon at 35 percent of height, plenty of uncluttered battle ground across the lower 65 percent. Two creatures will later be composited near lower left (28 percent x, 80 percent y) and middle right (76 percent x, 54 percent y), leave these areas clearly readable. Background scenery concentrated in the upper third and outer edges, thoughtful atmospheric depth and saturated natural palette. Beautiful warm lighting, appealing stylized shapes, texture kept subtle. No creatures, people, text, letters, numbers, logos, interface, borders, watermarks, or circles/platform ovals painted on the ground. One cohesive premium pixel-illustration style.
